title: Grade 2 Science — Wed, May 20
description: Plants Around Us — Day 3 of 5: Plants we eat
subject: science

questions.question: Which part of the carrot plant do we eat?
questions.explanation: We eat the root of a carrot. It grows underground and stores food. Other edible roots: radish, turnip, beetroot.

questions.question: Which part of the spinach plant do we eat?
questions.explanation: We eat the leaves of the spinach plant. Other edible leaves: cabbage, lettuce, methi (fenugreek).

questions.question: Which part of the sugarcane plant do we eat?
questions.explanation: We eat the stem of sugarcane. It is juicy and sweet. Sugar is made from sugarcane stem juice.

questions.question: We eat the ___ of a cauliflower plant.
questions.explanation: Cauliflower is the flower of the plant. Other edible flowers: broccoli, banana flower.

questions.question: Which part of the mango plant do we eat?
questions.explanation: We eat the fruit of the mango plant. Fruits contain seeds inside. Other fruits we eat: apple, banana, papaya.

questions.question: Which part of the pea plant do we eat?
questions.explanation: We eat the seeds of the pea plant. Seeds are found inside the pods. Other edible seeds: wheat, rice, dal (lentils).

questions.question: Potato is the ___ of the potato plant.
questions.explanation: Potato is a modified underground stem called a tuber. It stores food for the plant. Other stem vegetables: ginger, onion.

questions.question: Which of these is a fruit?
questions.explanation: Tomato is a fruit because it develops from a flower and contains seeds. In cooking we call it a vegetable, but botanically it is a fruit.

questions.question: Rice comes from the ___ of the rice plant.
questions.explanation: Rice is the seed of the rice plant. We eat rice seeds. Other seed foods: wheat (roti), maize (corn), pulses.

questions.question: We eat the root of which vegetable?
questions.explanation: Radish (mooli) is an edible root. We eat it raw in salads or cooked. Like carrot, it grows underground.

questions.question: Why do farmers grow plants?
options: To get food, wood, and other useful things
questions.explanation: Farmers grow plants for food (fruits, vegetables, grains), wood, medicine, cotton for clothes, and many other uses.

questions.question: Which of these do we eat as a leaf?
questions.explanation: We eat cabbage leaves. Cabbage is a leafy vegetable. Other leaf vegetables: lettuce, spinach, curry leaves.

questions.question: Tea is made from the ___ of the tea plant.
questions.explanation: Tea is made by drying and processing leaves of the tea plant. Tea gardens (like in Darjeeling) are where tea leaves are grown.

questions.question: Which part of ginger do we use in cooking?
questions.explanation: We use the underground stem (rhizome) of ginger. It has a strong spicy taste and is used in cooking and medicine.

questions.question: Cotton comes from which part of the cotton plant?
questions.explanation: Cotton fibres surround the seeds of the cotton plant inside its boll (fruit). The fluffy white cotton is used to make clothes.
